prompt: Finance wants one row for each account segment with the number of LedgerLoop subscriptions running on 31 December 2025, billed monthly and billed annually, and 0 where a segment has none of a kind. A subscription runs on that day when its start_date is on or before it and its end_date is missing or after it. Which query returns that, with the columns segment, monthly_subs and annual_subs?

options.text:
SELECT a.segment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.billing_period = 'monthly' THEN 1 END) AS monthly_subs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.billing_period = 'annual' THEN 1 END) AS annual_subs
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY a.segment

SELECT a.segment,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.billing_period = 'monthly') AS monthly_subs,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.billing_period = 'annual') AS annual_subs
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY a.segment

SELECT a.segment,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.billing_period = 'monthly') AS monthly_subs,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.billing_period = 'annual') AS annual_subs
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY a.segment, s.billing_period

SELECT a.segment,
  COUNT(s.billing_period = 'monthly') AS monthly_subs,
  COUNT(s.billing_period = 'annual') AS annual_subs
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY a.segment
